rules.why: Source Two DXF reveals 30.5-mm square mount and stack lists 30.5-mm nominal pattern. Bolt-hole/spacing and installation not yet qualified.
rules.action: Check actual bolt diameter, spacers, plate and board shape in 3D.

rules.why: No registered manufacturer STEP/GLB and stack Z-envelope for this pairing.
rules.action: Perform datum registration and collision check against actual mesh.

rules.why: 6S is within the motor documented 5–6S screening range.
rules.action: Confirm pack sag, connector, current and thermal limits.

rules.why: 6S is within the selected stack 2/3–6S rating.
rules.action: Check measured pack voltage transients and exact harness.

rules.why: Nominal ESC continuous per-channel exceeds max current in one T-Motor static test. Does not qualify thermal duty cycle.
rules.action: Measure application current, temperatures and harness bottlenecks.
Verify current, polarity, real connector gender and wiring before powering.

rules.why: SpeedyBee F405 V5 OX32 55A stack: DISCONTINUED. Retail listings are not real-time procurement authority.
rules.action: Choose a current, exact and demonstrably obtainable stack before ordering.

rules.why: Candidate advertises Betaflight; the current simulation contract targets PX4 and has no validated PX4 firmware target.
rules.action: Validate the exact autopilot and simulator path independently (do not assume Betaflight compatibility with PX4).

rules.why: No version-locked actual battery, receiver, video/BEC pinout integration is provided.
rules.action: Record source revision, ports, BEC load, UART assignment, continuity and props-off bench results.
Inspect fastener lengths/clearance against original mechanical drawings and actual motor.

rules.why: 4-mm manufacturer motor shaft value does not prove prop hub/retention fit.
rules.action: Inspect specific propeller revision, bore, fastener and directions.

rules.why: Measured XYZ motor centers and prop swept diameter not supplied.
rules.action: Extract motor XYZ from registered original STEP, inspect all 3D intersections and dynamic clearance.

rules.why: Motor centers are not measured or registered to source CAD.
rules.action: Check actual source revision, axes, datums and independent measurements.

rules.why: No weighed aircraft with installed battery and flight hardware.
rules.action: Attach test record with scale serial, method, revision and date.

rules.why: No measured baseline mass/CG and inertial tensor.
rules.action: Measure base CG and 6 inertial tensor components; include wiring/battery position.

rules.why: Missing measured inertias, motor coefficients, spin response, actual rotor mappings and valid PX4 target.
rules.action: Complete physical tests and then execute pinned SITL.
